item.title: French government to phase out use of Teams and Zoom
item.description: The first digital sovereignty initiative of its kind will require all state services and agencies to use the government's own WebRTC-based Visio platform by 2027. The post French government to phase out use of Teams and Zoom appeared first on AV Magazine.

item.title: Samsung’s 13” e-paper display is first to use phytoplankton
item.description: Some 45% of the display's housing is 45% recycled plastic and 10% phytoplankton-based bio-resin, cutting carbon emissions, in a model aimed at retail shelves, counters, tables and doors.
